estimate.input_tokens_basis: prompt UTF-8 bytes + 64 framing tokens (heuristic, not a provider token count)
estimate.label: ESTIMATE (not a guaranteed bound; the provider invoice is authoritative)
estimate.output_tokens_basis: max_tokens, documented as a strict limit that includes thinking tokens

label: PAID MODEL CALL APPROVAL REQUEST: one Messages API request under a supervised local procedure; does not authorize executing the response
not_verified_before_approval: account access, credits and the model's availability to this account
actual charges: the estimate and the estimate threshold are not provider-side limits; only a Console spend limit is
that the Console spend limit is set

single_use.mechanism: local ledger: an atomic exclusive marker named after approval_id, created outside the checkout immediately before the request is sent
single_use.procedure: one operator, one machine, one attempt. Any second attempt, including after a timeout, crash or otherwise ambiguous outcome, needs a newly prepared packet (new approval_id) and fresh explicit operator approval.
single_use.scope: this operator machine and ledger directory only; NOT enforced globally

spending_limit.estimate_threshold_meaning: this code refuses to send if its own pre-call ESTIMATE exceeds this value; it is not a limit on what the provider can charge
spending_limit.provider_side_limit: a Claude Console workspace spend limit, set by the operator; this code cannot verify it

what_approval_authorizes: one Messages API request with the bound parameters, from the bound commit, following the bound procedure
recording the bounded response and writing a review packet
what_approval_does_not_authorize: executing the response or any code derived from it
creating a pull request or merging anything
